additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400164-DC/SI-D/PL[170002799] - CMS is faulty CRM:00315002259
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The retractor practically did not work. We replaced it with a new one; when removing the old one, the clamp holding the cable also had to be replaced, as the nut began to rotate in the clamp housing.
A rather well-known defect in these clamps. The report will be completed early next week.
